steps.title: Analyze Loader and Sound Requirements
steps.description: Review UI/UX requirements for adding a premium 3D splash loader overlay with spatialized 3D sound synthesis on launch.

steps.title: Create Dark 3D Extrusion Backdrop Drawable
steps.description: Create a card_3d_dark_bg.xml resource to style the launching card container with dual depth layer rendering.

steps.title: Design 3D Stereophonic Sound Synthesizer
steps.description: Draft a panned sound synthesis function with modulated phase and gain sweeps to generate an orbital 3D spatial effect.

steps.title: Incorporate Launch Sound into SoundManager
steps.description: Add play3DLaunchSound() inside SoundManager.java utilizing 2-channel AudioTrack PCM streaming with cosine panners.

steps.title: Integrate Splash Overlay Layout into Main XML
steps.description: Modify activity_main.xml to include the layoutLaunchLoader overlay as the top-most z-order element with ThreeDLinearLayout support.

steps.title: Declare Overlay Controllers in MainActivity
steps.description: Map the RelativeLayout overlay, BeautifulLoaderView, and status TextView variables inside MainActivity's onCreate loop.

steps.title: Implement Transition and Animation Handlers
steps.description: Develop sequential delays inside MainActivity to dynamically transition loading text states, play 3D audio, and fade/scale out the splash.

steps.title: Verify Audio Buffer Stream Latency
steps.description: Review the audio generation parameters in SoundManager to ensure zero buffer underruns and immediate launch execution.

steps.title: Test Splash Interface View Hierarchy
steps.description: Ensure that the layout launch container consumes all touch gestures during initial loading to prevent background clicks.

steps.title: Verify Touch Gestures on 3D Splash Container
steps.description: Audit touch drag handlers of ThreeDLinearLayout to confirm interactive spatial rotation functions correctly during splash status.

steps.title: Building Smart Notes
steps.description: Initiate automated system compilation and packaging to produce the release-ready package.
